  AGENDA
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  August 5, 2019

11:30 a.m. – Small Executive Conference, 9th Floor

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Claims Review Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

  1. Approve the minutes of the July 29, 2019, meeting.

  2. Spectrum Business – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for services
  rendered.

  3. Integra Realty Resources - Executive session to discuss recommended payment for an
  appraisal of a vacant lot.

  4. Grafix Systems – Executive session to discuss payment for providing decals for police
  service vehicles.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Claims Review Committee on any matter connected with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

  Adjournment.

minutes_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  August 5, 2019

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Council Chambers, 9th floor at
11:30 a.m.:

  Members Present: Aisha Thompson, City Clerk
  Wanda Brown, Treasure’s Department
  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Ken Campos, City Attorney

  Staff Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Toya Ferguson, Finance Department
  Micah Herd, Police Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
  Member Velasquez reported no public comments.

  1. The minutes of July 29, 2019, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Spectrum Business – A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended
  settlement payment of $2,646.33. Motion carried unanimously.

  3. Integra Realty Resources – A motion was moved and seconded to approve the
  recommended settlement payment of $3,500.00. Motion carried unanimously.

  4. Grafix Systems - A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended
  settlement payment of $5,397.00. Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
  Member Heaney reported no public comments.

  There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 11:58 a.m.

Adjournment
